subject: Marine Works - Northumberland Strait - Loggiecroft
text:
Marine Works - Northumberland Strait - Loggiecroft
The amphibious, conventional and suction dredge Amphibex will be conducting dredging operations at Loggiecroft Channel starting on 010900UTC Jul, 2026, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Amphibex no. 2 and no. 6 will dredge areas within the channel and at the entrance to the wharves. The dredged material will be disposed of at ocean disposal sites via a pipeline and will vary. Minimum wash is requested in the vicinity of operations.
